title: Strict encode emits a 77-character line (exceeds RFC 76-char limit) before the final soft break
property: in strict mode (full RFC 1521 ruleset) every encoded line, including the trailing '=' of a soft break, is at most 76 characters
actual: first line is 70 'a' + '=00=00' + '=' = 77 characters; the soft break after the third-from-last octet is emitted without checking that the encoded octet fits
evidence: strict mode 'implements the full ruleset' of RFC 1521, whose rule #5 limits encoded lines to 76 characters; the code defines SAFE_LENGTH=73 to guarantee this but the third-from-last octet handling (pos += 3 then soft break when pos > SAFE_LENGTH-2) overshoots it
